HeaterSnapshot.description:
One heater, as a source reported it.

Every field is optional, because a source that reports no heater at all
reports none of these; each is a plausibility-ranged reported value in
degrees Celsius.

actual_c.description: The temperature the heater is at.

offset_c.description: The offset applied to this heater's target.

target_c.description: The temperature the heater is driving towards.

JobSnapshot.description:
The job a printer reports it is running.

Every field but `state` is optional: an absent one means the source did not
report it.

completion.description:
How far through the print is, as a fraction from zero to one.

Normalized to a fraction here regardless of how the source expresses it.

error.description: The error the source reports, when it reports one.

estimated_print_time_s.description: The whole print's estimated duration, in whole seconds.

file_name.description: The name of the file being printed, as the source reported it.

file_origin.description: Where the file lives, in the source's own vocabulary.

print_time_left_s.description: How long the print has left, in whole seconds.

print_time_s.description: How long the print has been running, in whole seconds.

state.description: The state the source reports the job to be in.

PrinterSnapshot.description: A printer, as a source reported it at one instant.

bed.description: The bed heater, when the printer reports one.

chamber.description: The chamber heater, when the printer reports one.

connection.description: The state the printer is in.

feedrate_factor.description: The feedrate multiplier, where one means one hundred percent.

flowrate_factor.description: The flowrate multiplier, where one means one hundred percent.

observed_at.description: The instant this observation was taken.

tools.description: The tool heaters, indexed by tool number.

PrinterState.description:
The state a source reports a printer or a print to be in.

The `unknown` arm exists so that a state nobody anticipated is recorded
carrying the source's own word for it rather than lost.

oneOf.description: A state this vocabulary does not name, in the source's own word for it.

Reported.description: A value as a source reported it, flagged when it is outside the plausibility range this crate declares for its field.
Reported.title: Reported

Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, as an RFC 3339 string with a zero offset.
Timestamp.title: Timestamp

description:
The supervisor looked in on an active print on its own schedule, with no
detector having said anything about it.

What a failure detector never alerts on — a progress that stopped moving, a
heater whose target fell to nothing mid-print, a fan cut at a bridge, a wall
going thin — is still on the machine and in the camera's frame, so every
active print is given one of these each interval and a turn on it. It
carries what the printer reported as it was taken; the frame the camera gave
at the same moment, untagged by any detector, is this event's image.

interval_s.description: How often these are taken, in whole seconds.

job.description:
The job the printer reported as the observation was taken, absent when
it could not be read.

printer.description:
The printer's state as the observation was taken, absent when it could
not be read — which the history records as a port failure.
